errors.text_span: Третият по големина сектор, в синьо, е „потребителски стоки“ с 25,4%, а най-малкият, в лилаво, е „енергийни ресурси“ с 11,3%.
errors.evidence: The description swaps the order implied by size: 25,4% (blue) is larger than 24,3% (green), so blue is not the third largest; it is the second largest. The statement also misstates the ranking of the sectors.

The description does not mention the exploded/separated slices visible in the pie chart, beyond a brief note about the largest sector being slightly offset; it omits that all sectors are shown in a 3D exploded pie style.
